summary: The extract filter gets a value from a list or dict by index or key, equivalent to list[index] or dict[key], mainly useful with map.
questions: How do I look up several keys from a dict using map?
How do I get values from hostvars for a list of hosts?
What does the extract filter do?

answer_card.title: extract filter
answer_card.answer_md: `extract` returns `container[index_or_key]`, like `list[index]` or `dict[key]`, but as a filter so you can combine it with `map`, e.g. `{{ keys | map('extract', mydict) }}`. The index/key must match the container type.
